semiconductor_relevance: High — Toei specializes in evaluation and inspection equipment for magnetic devices, which are critical in semiconductor applications.
summary: Toei Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced evaluation and inspection equipment specifically for magnetic devices used in semiconductor applications. Their technology enhances testing capabilities for STT-MRAM wafer testing, significantly improving inspection efficiency and accuracy.
capabilities: Second-generation memory system for STT-MRAM wafer testing
